findings.suggested_fix: Keep the empty-field evaluation guard and export blocking, but render a distinct zero-destination message before the dirty/busy preview branch, such as 'Add an output column or import a template to start the preview.' Cover first upload and removal of the last output in a browser regression.
findings.title: Empty destinations leave preview permanently updating

testing_gaps: The introduced template-replacement confirmation has no regression covering Keep current columns, successful replacement, or failed template parsing preserving existing fields; current conversion coverage imports a template only into an empty destination list.

The new editable-during-evaluation path is tested for successful latest-generation completion (tests/e2e/row-mapping.spec.ts:126), while cancellation/retry tests cover replacement imports with an already settled mapping (tests/e2e/performance.spec.ts:66,100). Add a delayed-run test that edits the draft, cancels the older evaluation, retries the active file, and asserts the newest headers and downloaded bytes only become available after its evaluation; this exercises pendingGeneration/failedGeneration recovery and the preserved session workflow together.

The delayed-run test covers successful completion of an older generation, while the existing cancellation test cancels a source replacement. Add a regression that cancels an evaluation after editing a newer draft, retries the active file, and asserts that only the newest draft becomes exportable; this exercises pendingGeneration/failedGeneration and recovery together.
